title: Local incident (synchronised version) v1
description: One version of a site-local incident. Identity is not carried in the payload: site_id and tenant_id are derived from the authenticated site certificate. Central links this to a central incident using (site_id, local_incident_id); versions must increase monotonically.

local_incident_id.description: Site-local incident id, stable across versions.

version.description: Monotonic version. Duplicate version = ack; lower version = stale, ignore; same version with different content = conflict, reject and audit.

severity.description: Highest severity of the correlated events.

status.description: Incident state. Transitions are governed by the state machine in SPEC section 6; every transition is appended to history.

opened_at.description: Time the incident was opened, UTC RFC 3339.

updated_at.description: Time this version was produced, UTC RFC 3339. Must be >= opened_at.

resolved_at.description: Time the incident reached RESOLVED, or null while open.

entity_refs.description: Entities involved in the incident, ordered from root to symptom when known.

kind.description: Entity kind, consistent with the event envelope.

event_ids.description: Event ids correlated into this incident. Used for evidence and replay/audit.
